LanguageData.Accurate_Tip: Only when the trait is completely given trait will it be satisfied
LanguageData.DialogCondition_Bool_Tip: Obtain the bool value from the quest database to determine whether to pass
LanguageData.DialogCondition_And_Tip: If all sub conditions are true, return true. Otherwise, it is false. The reason for failure is the reason for the condition that is false
LanguageData.DialogCondition_Or_Tip: Any of the sub conditions that are true will return true, otherwise it will be false, and the failure reason will be customized reason of condition
LanguageData.DialogCondition_QuestIsGenerated_Tip: If the provided quest has been generated in the game, return false
LanguageData.DialogCondition_Reversal_Tip: Return the value of the reversed sub condition
LanguageData.DialogCondition_QuestState_Tip: If no quest def is given, automatically retrieve the quest from the target of the triggering condition
LanguageData.DialogCondition_CapturedPawn_Tip: Determine whether the given capture trap, such as a capture net, has captured pawn
LanguageData.DialogCondition_ThingInPosition_Tip: Determine whether the given thing is located at the given position (if the given position includes a map, the map will also be determined)
LanguageData.DialogCondition_SkillCheck_Tip: Roll a random number between 0 and 20. If the result is lower than the target's corresponding skill level plus the check modifier, the condition is passed.
LanguageData.WorldCondition_And_Tip: All sub world conditions must be true.
LanguageData.WorldCondition_Or_Tip: Any sub world condition can be true.
LanguageData.WorldCondition_Reversal_Tip: Returns the opposite result of the selected world condition.
LanguageData.ZoneCondition_Size_Tip: Passes only when both the map part width and height are within the configured ranges.
LanguageData.ZoneCondition_Tag_Tip: Passes when the map part contains at least one of the specified map tags.
LanguageData.ZoneCondition_Wealth_Tip: It will met,when the player's wealth is not within the set range or when sub conditions are met.
LanguageData.ZoneCondition_CoreTag_Tip: Without Invert result, cores with a matching tag are excluded; with it enabled, only matching cores are accepted as docking cores.
LanguageData.ZoneCondition_Invert_Tip: Inverts the result of the selected sub-condition.
LanguageData.ZoneCondition_FactionMeme_Tip: Passes when the selected faction's primary ideology contains the specified meme.
